Part of the broader Central European family of 'LÃ³rum' and 'King' games, but evolved in the Slovak regions to emphasize solo bidding and 'Big/Small' contracts.
4 players. A dealer deals 8 cards to each player.
32 cards (standard Slovak deck). No permanent trumps.
